name: College of Computer Studies
description: Offers the Bachelor of Science in Information Technology and Associate in Computer Technology programs, preparing students for careers in computing, software, systems, and information technology.

name: College of Maritime Education
description: Offers the Bachelor of Science in Marine Transportation program for careers in maritime operations and ship engineering.

name: College of Business Administration
description: Provides programs across Accountancy, Business Administration, Finance, Management, Marketing, and Taxation, developing skills for business and professional practice.

name: College of Engineering
description: Offers Civil and Mechanical Engineering programs.

name: College of Health Sciences
description: Offers the Bachelor of Science in Nursing and Bachelor of Science in Medical Technology, preparing students for compassionate, competent, and professional health care service.

name: College of Education
description: Offers Bachelor of Elementary Education and Bachelor of Secondary Education programs with majors in English, Mathematics, Physical Education, and Social Studies.

name: College of Arts and Sciences
description: Offers the Bachelor of Arts in English Language Studies, developing communication, language, research, and critical-thinking skills for further study and professional work.

name: College of Criminology
description: Offers the Bachelor of Science in Criminology, preparing students for careers and service related to law enforcement, public safety, criminal justice, and community protection.
